_experiment.description: Neuron-level MAGNITUDE pruning on the reference [196,10,10,10] network. Structured counterpart to the weight-level magnitude ablation: each step removes the hidden neuron (row of W[l] + column of W[l+1] + bias b[l][i]) with the smallest mean(|w|) over its active weights, then adjusts via gradient descent on d_W. Shares neuron_sparsification_log.csv schema with e11 (manifold) / e21 (obd) / e22 (obs) for direct comparison of the selection criterion.
